profile.description: Four-day family county fair in Jamestown featuring 4-H and open-class exhibits, carnival rides, fair food, entertainment, livestock events and shows, contests, and additional fairgrounds programming. Verified 2026 dates were June 24–27; 2027 fair dates and vendor/entertainment application timing were not published as of August 31, 2026.

notes.subject: 2027 prospect research — reviewed August 31, 2026
notes.body: The official Stutsman County Fair site lists 4-H, open-class exhibits, carnival rides, entertainment, food, livestock events, contests, and the fairgrounds at 3325 83rd Ave SE in Jamestown. Deb Hatlewick is listed as a board director, and HAFFE listed the 2026 fair for June 24–27. No official 2027 dates or application opening were found. Sources: https://www.stutsmancountyfair.com/ and https://www.stutsmancountyfair.com/p/about/board-of-directors

notes.subject: EMAIL DRAFT — review only; do not send
notes.body:
Subject: Stutsman County Fair — early 2027 Adventure Zone planning

Hi Deb,

It was great meeting you through the HAFFE convention. With Stutsman County Fair’s four days of 4-H and open exhibits, carnival rides, fair food, and family entertainment, I wanted to reach out early about 2027.

The Adventure Zone brings a fully staffed inflatable bounce house carnival, with setup, operation, and teardown included. We can discuss a prepaid package or, where appropriate, a pay-for-play arrangement. Would you be open to a short conversation once your 2027 dates and attraction plans begin taking shape?

Best,
Desiree
The Adventure Zone
America’s Best Inflatable Bounce House Carnival
